event_text: Louis VII of France lays siege to Damascus during the Second Crusade.
headline: Crusaders Besiege Damascus in 1148 Fiasco
story: Barry gazed out at the Crusader army below, Susan beside him on the minaret. 'Louis VII of France, laying siege to Damascus. Second Crusade, and it's not exactly going to plan.' Susan preened her feathers. 'Conrad III of Germany and Louis were supposed to take Edessa back from the Turks, but that didn't work out. Now they're here, camped outside Damascus, trying to decide who's in charge.' Barry snorted. 'King Baldwin III of Jerusalem is trying to get them to attack the Turks to the north, but Louis is having none of it. He wants to take Damascus, and the whole thing is starting to look like a right mess.' Susan ruffled her feathers. 'It's only been a few days, and they're already struggling. The sun, the lack of water... it's not exactly the most well-planned siege.' Barry took off into the sky. 'I suppose it's no surprise it ended in a retreat, really. The Crusaders just didn't have the manpower or the supplies to take the city.'
regret_line: Perhaps they should have read the guidebook on desert sieges before booking the trip.
winner_line: The Turks, who got to watch their enemies argue and flail about in the desert.
